meta.name: Highway Dividend With Annual-Report Spot-Checked Segment Purity V5.4e
meta.objective: Rerun the V5.4d segment-purity hypothesis after annual-report spot checks confirm Eastmoney segment item names in sampled original reports. Direct traffic/toll/concession fields remain diagnostic candidates only.

universe.name: A-share toll-road operators with visible segment evidence
universe.construction: JoinQuant HY03160 highway industry membership, filtered by Eastmoney/Tushare visible segment evidence. Non-highway-contaminated rows are excluded. A 2024 annual-report sample spot-check supports the segment evidence source but does not yet fully review all history.

data.vendor: JoinQuant/DataJQ + Eastmoney F10 BusinessAnalysis + Tushare disclosure_date + CNINFO annual-report sample spot check
data.segment_visibility_policy: latest segment evidence with visible_date <= trade_date
data.operating_field_policy: Traffic volume, toll revenue, concession years and toll policy are extracted as candidates only and are not used as formal scoring factors until manual review is complete.
data.source_warning: V5.4e strengthens segment-source confidence but still lacks fully reviewed direct operating fields.

factors.name: highway_revenue_ratio
factors.source: Eastmoney F10 segment evidence joined with Tushare report visible date, sample checked against CNINFO annual reports
factors.definition: Revenue ratio classified as toll-road/highway/road-bridge business.

factors.name: non_highway_revenue_ratio
factors.source: Eastmoney F10 segment evidence joined with Tushare report visible date, sample checked against CNINFO annual reports
factors.definition: Revenue ratio not classified as highway/toll-road business.

factors.name: capex_burden
factors.definition: Capex divided by operating cash flow.

scoring.value_trap_guard: No direct traffic/toll/concession factor is used until original-report values are manually reviewed.

portfolio.cash_policy: hold residual cash when fewer than 8 names pass filters

defensive_rule.reason: V5.4e tests business-purity validation after source spot-check, not timing.

individual_stop_loss_take_profit.reason: Fixed exits are not part of the research hypothesis.

validation.acceptance_rule: V5.4e can only move to Engineering if PM accepts the remaining source-review gap. Historical return alone is insufficient.
